cards.spoken_script: Your AI can draft the reply without making the promise. Imagine a customer asking when something will arrive. Use a fictional request for the first test. Give the assistant only approved facts and a clear instruction to flag anything it cannot confirm. In this example, the draft promises tomorrow. Our approved information does not support that date. The next step is a person checking the request, not the message going straight to the customer. That person corrects the draft, confirms any promise, and decides whether to send it. Keep the boundary visible: prepare, review, then send. A missing fact returns to the process owner. Map one routine reply today. Mark the exact point where a human must decide.
cards.synthesis_note: Transfer visible handoffs and ownership distinctions while removing replacement claims, sales promises and autonomous sending.
